title: BHASHABENCH V1: A Comprehensive Benchmark for the Quadrant of Indic Domains

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot multiple-choice accuracy of large language models on equivalent professional exam questions in English versus Hindi to identify resource and performance disparities.

Evaluating zero-shot accuracy of models on specialized India-centric knowledge domains (e.g., Ayurveda, Indian Law, Indian Agriculture, Indian Finance) to identify performance gaps in non-Western, culturally specific contexts.
